extensionDescription.message: Quickly change video and audio playback speed between 1x, 1.2x, 1.5x, and 2x.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description in the browser's extension list and store.

commandDescription.description: The keyboard shortcut's name in the browser's keyboard shortcuts settings.

speedShown.description: The speed as the on-page indicator shows it, such as 1.5x.

speedSpoken.description: What screen readers announce when the speed changes.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button once the speed is changed. The speed reads as the indicator shows it, such as 1.5x; the extension's name stays in English.
